name: replay-theater
description: Pane that records the session's tool calls and replays them step by step or on a timer.

openPaneAtStart.title: Open the pane at start
openPaneAtStart.description: Open the Replay Theater pane when a session begins; off opens it only with /replay.

playSpeedMs.title: Playback speed (ms per step)
playSpeedMs.description: Delay between steps while playing. Lower is faster.

maxSteps.title: Steps to keep
maxSteps.description: How many recent tool calls the recording holds.
